Dafny specification:

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.  
In this case:

```dafny
method BitwiseXorSequences(seq1: seq<nat>, seq2: seq<nat>) returns (result: seq<nat>)
    requires seq1 != null && seq2 != null
    requires |seq1| == |seq2|
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |seq1|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == seq1[i] ^ seq2[i]
{
    var res := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < |seq1|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |seq1|
        invariant |res| == i
        invariant forall j :: 0 <= j < i ==> res[j] == seq1[j] ^ seq2[j]
    {
        res := res + [seq1[i] ^ seq2[i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
    result := res;
}
```
